name: Computer Science
tagline: The highest-leverage degree in Pakistan right now.

salaryRange.note: Local + remote/freelance; USD roles pay far more

description: The most direct path into Pakistan's fastest-growing export sector. Degree + portfolio can land work before graduation.

dayInLife.title: Your code breaks in production.
dayInLife.scenario: It's 4 PM and a feature you shipped is down.

options.label: Reproduce, debug, fix, test
options.result: You ship a fix in an hour. Debugging is 60% of the job.
options.insight: Frustration tolerance beats raw intelligence in CS.

options.label: Ask AI to rewrite it
options.result: It helps, but you still must understand why it failed.
options.insight: AI is a tool, not a substitute for understanding.

realityCheck: The entry test (NET/NU) — not FSc marks — decides NUST/FAST admission.

name: Artificial Intelligence
tagline: The field rewriting every other field.

salaryRange.note: ML engineers command top pay; remote USD roles higher

whyNow.value: AI named a priority export area by P@SHA

description: Build systems that learn. Pakistan's export firms are explicitly expanding into AI, robotics and automation.

dayInLife.title: Your model's accuracy is stuck at 78%.
dayInLife.scenario: The client wants 90%. Deadline is Friday.

options.label: Investigate the data quality first
options.result: You find mislabeled rows. Fixing data jumps you to 91%.
options.insight: 80% of ML is data, not algorithms.

options.label: Try fancier architectures
options.result: Marginal gains, lost time. The real issue was data.

realityCheck: AI degrees are new; what matters is your portfolio and math foundation.

name: Cybersecurity

salaryRange.note: SOC, pentesting and global remote roles

description: Protect systems and networks. Driven by Pakistan's National Cybersecurity Policy and global cyber talent shortage.

dayInLife.title: An alert fires at 2 AM.
dayInLife.scenario: Suspicious login attempts on a client system.

options.label: Triage, contain, document
options.result: You contain it before damage. Clean incident report.
options.insight: Calm under pressure is the core skill.

options.label: Ignore until morning
options.result: The breach escalates overnight. Bad outcome.

realityCheck: Certifications (Security+, CEH) matter as much as the degree here.

name: Data Science

salaryRange.note: Analytics, BI and ML roles across industries

description: Analyze data to drive business decisions. Applies to tech, finance, healthcare and more — a versatile, portable skill.

dayInLife.title: Execs need a decision by noon.

options.label: Clean, analyze, visualize the key insight
options.result: You deliver one clear chart that drives the decision.
options.insight: Clarity is the product, not complexity.

options.label: Show every possible metric
options.result: They drown in charts and decide nothing.

realityCheck: The Google Data Analytics cert can get you started in months, before any degree.

name: Electrical Engineering
description: Classic engineering with stable demand in power, telecom and electronics — and a bridge into embedded systems and IoT.

dayInLife.title: A circuit board keeps failing.
dayInLife.scenario: You must find why before production.

options.label: Systematically isolate each component
options.result: You find a thermal issue and redesign it.

options.label: Replace the whole board
options.result: It works this time but fails at scale later.
options.insight: Root cause matters more than quick fixes.

realityCheck: ECAT (UET) and NET (NUST) are the gatekeepers — prep is everything.

name: FinTech
description: Finance meets technology: mobile wallets, digital payments, lending. One of Pakistan's hottest, most-funded startup spaces.

dayInLife.title: A wallet feature launches to 1M users.
dayInLife.scenario: Transaction failures spike on day one.

options.label: Trace the failure path end-to-end
options.result: You find a rate-limit bug and fix it fast.

options.label: Wait for user reports
options.result: The backlog grows and trust erodes.
options.insight: In fintech, silence is a bug.

realityCheck: You don't need a CS degree to break into fintech — product and analytics roles are wide open.

name: Accounting & Finance

salaryRange.note: CA/ACCA path pays more over time

description: The foundation of every organization. ACCA/CA is a globally portable qualification with strong local demand.

dayInLife.title: The books don't balance.
dayInLife.scenario: A client's records are off by a large amount.

options.label: Trace each transaction methodically
options.result: You find the error and reconcile it.
options.insight: Detail orientation is the whole job.

options.label: Estimate and move on
options.result: The error compounds and audit fails.

realityCheck: ACCA/CA is often a smarter ROI than a generic BBA for I.Com students.

name: Business Administration
tagline: Learn to build, lead and sell.
description: Broad business education with paths into marketing, sales, HR and operations — or entrepreneurship.

options.label: Interview users and iterate
options.result: You find the real objection and pivot the message.

options.label: Double the ad spend
options.result: More spend, same result. Money can't fix a wrong message.

realityCheck: A BBA's value is your internships and network, not the lectures.
